themeVariantPopoverWasOpen.description: True if the theme variant popover was visible when the drawer was opened

oneOf.title: Omnibar Model Picker Shown
oneOf.description: Fired once when the user opens the omnibar model picker. This is a picker impression; it does not imply that the user activated a model or an upsell.

oneOf.title: Omnibar Model Picker Try For Free Shown
oneOf.description: Fired when the user activates a gated model row whose displayed CTA is 'Try for free', immediately before the web UI requests the native subscription upsell. Despite the historical '_shown' suffix, this is an activation event, not an impression.

oneOf.title: Omnibar Model Picker Upgrade Shown
oneOf.description: Fired when the user activates a gated model row whose resolved upsell presentation is 'Upgrade'. This activation bucket is derived from the item's upsell type and free-trial eligibility; the following native route is still determined by the item's upsell value, so this event can precede a subscription-upsell request. Despite the historical '_shown' suffix, this is an activation event, not an impression.

oneOf.title: Omnibar Reasoning Picker Shown
oneOf.description: Fired once when the user opens the omnibar reasoning picker. This is a picker impression; it does not imply that the user activated a reasoning effort or an upsell.

oneOf.title: Omnibar Reasoning Picker Try For Free Shown
oneOf.description: Fired when the user activates a gated reasoning-effort row whose displayed CTA is 'Try for free', immediately before the web UI requests the native subscription upsell. Despite the historical '_shown' suffix, this is an activation event, not an impression.

oneOf.title: Omnibar Reasoning Picker Upgrade Shown
oneOf.description: Fired when the user activates a gated reasoning-effort row whose resolved upsell presentation is 'Upgrade'. This activation bucket is derived from the item's upsell type and free-trial eligibility; the following native route is still determined by the item's upsell value, so this event can precede a subscription-upsell request. Despite the historical '_shown' suffix, this is an activation event, not an impression.

oneOf.title: Omnibar Screenshot Taken
oneOf.description: Fired once a screenshot returned by `omnibar_captureScreenshot` has been added to the prompt as an image chip.

oneOf.title: Omnibar Screenshot Removed
oneOf.description: Fired when the user removes a screenshot image chip.

oneOf.title: Omnibar Screenshot Failed
oneOf.description: Fired when the page could not process a screenshot that native returned. Native capture failures (`error` replies) are reported by native, not by this event.

oneOf.title: Omnibar Image Attached
oneOf.description: Fired for every image chip added to the prompt, from the file picker, a paste, or a screenshot.

oneOf.title: Omnibar Image Removed
oneOf.description: Fired for every image chip the user removes.
